# Epping Forest

Epping Forest is an ancient woodland stretching 13 miles from East London into Essex.

Epping Forest is a charity that preserves and protects the Forest, with the City of London Corporation as Conservators and Trustee.

The Forest has been maintained as a public open space since the passing of the Epping Forest Act 1878.
